stepTitle: An oscillation is defined by $$h(t)=3\sin({\pi}t-\pi/4)+1.$$ Identify the correct graph. \n Four trig functions displayed on separate axes; all attain a maximum value of $$4$$ and a minimum value of negative $$2$$. Function A achieves two sequential maxima when $$x$$ is $$0.25$$ and $$-1.75$$. Function B achieves two sequential maxima when $$x$$ is $$0.75$$ and $$-1.25$$. Function C achieves two sequential maxima when $$x$$ is $$0.5$$ and $$1.5$$. Function D achieves two sequential maxima when $$x$$ is $$0.75$$ and $$1.75$$.
